note: Wooded RV park on Spring Hill Rd off Old Greensboro Rd, near Chapel Hill and Carrboro; convenient to UNC and Duke (graduations, medical stays). Quiet shaded lots down a gravel road. Campers more than 10 years old need the owner's approval. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms 64 full-hookup sites with 30/50-amp, pull-throughs, Wi-Fi; added no bathhouse/laundry, phone-only booking. No rates posted anywhere on the site (price only from the RV Life $$ tier). Season year-round left derived (site silent). Note cleaned of hookup/pull-through/year-round text and the unsupported 'no age restriction'. good_sam false left (Good Sam directory).
flags: Compromised website: springhillpark.com (pages dated 2010-2012) carries injected spam - a 'super clones' replica-watch paragraph and globenewswire link on the home page, a 'sydneylint virtual girlfriend' sentence in the Park Rules. Phone 919-967-4268 matches the site.

Long-stay test 2: no nightly (or any) rate posted and no booking engine - reservations by phone only. The park is partly long-stay in character: the site addresses 'the full-time RVer and weekend explorer alike' and its rules have an 'Extended Stay Guests' section billing monthly lot rent, electric, propane and storage, while also courting short stays (graduations, Duke/UNC medical treatment, a reviewer's two-night stay). Nightly share not stated.
Rig age rule: 'No camper allowed older than 10yrs unless approved by Park owner.'
